summary: The current migrated launcher source still lacked the open upstream fix. Added explicit 1..1024 thread-block checks and empty-grid no-op returns to both fused post-quant launchers, plus a source regression covering the masked and contiguous variants. The assigned gfx950 system cannot compile this CUDA-specific JIT source because cuda_fp8.h is unavailable under the prepared ROCm toolchain, so the candidate could not be executed or numerically validated here.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression against the recorded base source: both masked and contiguous launcher tests failed because the block-limit guard was absent. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/regression_before.log

Passing-after source regression: both launchers bound the block to at most 1024 threads; masked zero-token/zero-topk and contiguous zero-token paths return after parameter validation and before LaunchKernel. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/regression_after.log

Attempted the reported empty contiguous path on the assigned gfx950 GPU. The actual JIT compilation stopped before launch because hipcc could not find cuda_fp8.h. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/before_contig_tokens_0_hidden_512.log
Attempted the reported empty masked path on gfx950; compilation stopped at the same CUDA-only header prerequisite. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/before_masked_tokens_0_hidden_512_topk_1.log
Attempted the independent zero-topk masked boundary on gfx950; compilation stopped at cuda_fp8.h before launch. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/before_masked_tokens_1_hidden_512_topk_0.log
Attempted an oversized 1088-thread block on gfx950; compilation stopped at cuda_fp8.h before launch. Raw output: reports/j-b5df533cf10f/raw/before_contig_tokens_1_hidden_8704.log

gpu_execution_evidence: PyTorch detected exactly one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), allocated and initialized the CUDA-device tensors used by each reproduction, and invoked hipcc with --offload-arch=gfx950. The issue kernel itself did not execute because compilation failed first.
remaining_limitations: No CUDA GPU/toolchain was assigned. The CUDA-specific source includes cuda_fp8.h unconditionally, which is absent from the prepared ROCm 7.2 installation, so failing-before and passing-after kernel launches could not be observed.
No DeepSeek model weights or multi-rank environment were available; the reported DP-attention idle-rank serving path was not reproduced.
GPU numerical equivalence for non-empty inputs was not measured because the JIT module could not compile on gfx950.
The regression is a source-contract test, not a compiled CUDA execution test. CUDA CI should compile and execute the direct cases retained in reproduce_post_quant_launch.py.
